{{Quote|Enjoy a giant Neuvian sundae made the old-fashioned way with two generous scoops of denta bean ice cream and your choice of Trammistan chocolate or zoochberry topping. Served with atomically aerated cream and a zherry on top.|Dex's Diner menu, on its Neuvian sundae|<ref name="Menu" />}}
A '''zherry''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]].<ref name="Starships & Vehicles 3">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|3|Star Wars A&ndash;Z}}</ref> The [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], used topped their [[Neuvian sundae]]s with a zherry. The diner also offered zherry [[Syrup/Legends|syrup]] flavoring for the [[fizzyglug]] drinks it sold.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Everything sounds cooler when spelled with a "z"|Gregory Walker on naming the zherry|<ref name="Story Behind">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>}}
A zherry was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
